prompt_text: Which title company in West Palm Beach FL is best for a home closing?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t enough reliable, comparable review information here to name one company definitively as “best.” **Integrity Land Title** is one local option to consider: it lists a West Palm Beach office at **2101 Vista Parkway, Suite 130**, phone **(561) 684-6262**. **Trusted Florida Title** is another, at **1663 S. Congress Avenue**, phone **(561) 899-4435**.

Before choosing, ask each for a written estimate of title and closing fees, who will handle your file, how they communicate updates, and whether they can meet your closing timeline. Verify the agency’s Florida license through the Florida Department of Financial Services, and compare recent reviews for the specific office or closing agent. You can also ask your real-estate attorney or lender for recommendations; you’re generally not required to use the agent suggested by the other party.
